The Haunted House. A sprawling, dilapidated Victorian mansion with broken windows, overgrown gardens, and an eerie aura.

SCENE LAYERS:
- Background: The Gloomwood Estate looms in the distance, a hulking silhouette against a bruised, dusk sky. Tall, gnarled trees, their branches skeletal and bare, claw at the heavens, shrouded in thick, swirling tendrils of heavy fog that obscure the upper reaches of the mansion. The fog lends an otherworldly haze to the entire scene, blurring the lines between reality and the supernatural.
- Midground: The Haunted House itself dominates the midground. It's a sprawling, dilapidated Victorian mansion, its once-grand facade now a testament to decades of neglect. Broken panes of glass stare out like vacant eyes from countless windows, some boarded up haphazardly, others gaping open to the elements. Rotting eaves sag precariously, and dark, gaping holes hint at the decay within. Overgrown, thorny vines crawl up the chipped stone walls, their sickly green hues a stark contrast to the muted grays of the decaying wood. A grand, wrought-iron gate, partially ajar and rusted, marks the entrance to the property, hinting at a path swallowed by the encroaching wilderness.
- Foreground: The foreground comprises the immediate surroundings of the estate's boundary, viewed from street-level. A cracked and overgrown cobblestone path leads towards the gate, barely visible beneath a carpet of dead leaves and weeds. The air is thick with dampness and the scent of decay. Cobwebs, ancient and undisturbed, drape across fallen branches and the lower portions of the gate, adding to the palpable sense of abandonment and foreboding.

LIGHTING: The dying light of dusk casts long, distorted shadows that stretch and writhe across the facade of the mansion. The heavy fog diffuses any remaining sunlight, creating a muted, ethereal glow. Hints of flickering candlelight can be glimpsed through some of the broken windows, casting faint, unsteady beams that barely pierce the oppressive gloom. The overall lighting is shadow-drenched, contributing to the melancholic and haunting atmosphere.
ATMOSPHERE: An eerie aura permeates the Gloomwood Estate. The heavy fog and the approaching darkness amplify the supernatural presence and the melancholic atmosphere of the decaying grandeur. The scene is steeped in a foreboding mystery, a palpable sense of history and sorrow clinging to the very stones of the Haunted House.

Visual Identity: haunted architecture, victorian decay, supernatural presence, melancholic atmosphere, decaying grandeur
Forms & Materials: rotting wood, chipped stone, cobwebs, aged wallpaper, gothic architecture, broken panes, rotting eaves, overgrown vines

[SPACE:] EXTERIOR - OUTSIDE view of the building/location
[ENVIRONMENT:] heavy fog, dusk
[CAMERA:] camera positioned on approach path with elevated perspective, 25-30° downward tilt, ultra-wide view capturing entrance within broader environmental context, entrance visible but not dominating frame, extensive surroundings visible, layered depth from immediate foreground through distant background, balanced composition showing full architectural context
[LENS:] 12-24mm ultra-wide lens, elevated perspective, expansive framing
[LIGHT:] directional natural light with atmospheric haze, environmental motion (wind-blown mist, drifting clouds, shifting shadows), parallax depth through weather conditions

[NEG:] bright colors, modern amenities, cheerful characters, interior, indoor, inside room, indoor scene

[FILTER: NoLivingSubjects] DON'T INCLUDE: humans, people, faces, characters, animals, creatures, silhouettes, bodies, watermark, signature.
